BatchNorm vs LayerNorm vs GroupNorm vs I.zh: BatchNorm 与 LayerNorm、GroupNorm、InstanceNorm 之比较
BatchNorm vs LayerNorm vs GroupNorm vs I.src: BatchNorm vs LayerNorm vs GroupNorm vs InstanceNorm

Four normalization layers, one equation.zh:
四种归一化层，共享同一种方程形式：减去均值，再除以标准差。
      唯一的差别在于@@T0@@均值与方差是在激活张量的哪一@@T1@@@@T2@@切片@@T3@@上进行池化。
      正是这一设计选择，使得 BatchNorm 主宰了 CNN、LayerNorm 主宰了 Transformer，
      而 GroupNorm 拯救了小批量训练。在下方选择一种归一化，
      观察究竟哪些元素共享同一个统计量。
Four normalization layers, one equation.src: Four normalization layers, one equation shape: subtract a mean, divide by a standard deviation. The only thing that changes is which slice of the activation tensor the mean and variance are pooled over. That single design choice is why BatchNorm ruled CNNs, LayerNorm rules Transformers, and GroupNorm rescued small-batch training. Pick a norm below and watch exactly which elements share one statistic.

@@T0@@约 12 分钟@@T1@@

@@T0@@Try this.@@T1@@ Keep the reference.zh:
@@T0@@试试这个。@@T1@@ 固定参考方块，在
      @@T2@@BatchNorm@@T3@@ 与 @@T4@@LayerNorm@@T5@@ 之间来回切换。观察均值指示器：
      BatchNorm 在整个批上对一个完整通道做池化，所以当你点击另一个样本时，
      其统计量几乎不动——而 LayerNorm 会为@@T6@@每个@@T7@@样本重新计算一个
      全新的均值，因此它会跃变。这种批与样本之分正是全部要点：BatchNorm
      把各样本耦合在一起（大批量时极佳，小批量时脆弱）；
      LayerNorm 则让每个样本各自独立（对变长的 Transformer
      序列而言再合适不过）。现在把 GroupNorm 下的 $G$ 从 $1$ 拖到 $C$——当 $G=1$ 时它
      @@T8@@就是@@T9@@ InstanceNorm，当 $G=C$ 时它 @@T10@@就是@@T11@@ LayerNorm。
@@T0@@Try this.@@T1@@ Keep the reference.src: Try this. Keep the reference tile fixed and flip between BatchNorm and LayerNorm. Watch the mean pill: BatchNorm pools a whole channel across the batch, so its statistic barely moves when you click a different sample — but LayerNorm re-computes a fresh mean for each sample, so it jumps. That batch-vs-sample split is the entire story: BatchNorm couples examples together (great with big batches, fragile with tiny ones); LayerNorm treats every example alone (perfect for variable-length Transformer sequences). Now drag $G$ under GroupNorm from $1$ up to $C$ — at $G=1$ it is InstanceNorm, and at $G=C$ it is LayerNorm.

Why each wins where it wins.zh: 各自为何在其擅长的场合取胜
Why each wins where it wins.src: Why each wins where it wins

@@T0@@CNNs with large batches &middot; B.zh:
@@T0@@大批量 CNN · BatchNorm。@@T1@@ 一个通道是一个
        在每个空间位置、每张图像上重复应用的特征检测器，因此
        $N\!\cdot\!H\!\cdot\!W$ 个样本能给出其均值的稳定估计。问题在于：
        该统计量依赖于@@T2@@整个批@@T3@@，所以批大小为 2–4 时（在
        检测/分割中很常见）它会变得噪声很大，而且训练与评估之间必须切换为
        滑动平均。
@@T0@@CNNs with large batches &middot; B.src: CNNs with large batches · BatchNorm. A channel is a repeated feature detector applied at every spatial location and every image, so $N\!\cdot\!H\!\cdot\!W$ samples give a stable estimate of its mean. The catch: the statistic depends on the whole batch, so a batch of 2–4 (common in detection/segmentation) makes it noisy, and train vs eval must swap in running averages.

@@T0@@Transformers &amp; RNNs &middot; L.zh:
@@T0@@Transformer 与 RNN · LayerNorm。@@T1@@ 序列长度
        各异，批量大小可能为 1，因此@@T2@@不依赖批@@T3@@至关重要。
        LayerNorm 各自独立地归一化每个词元的特征向量——
        训练与评估时行为完全一致，无需滑动统计量。
@@T0@@Transformers &amp; RNNs &middot; L.src: Transformers & RNNs · LayerNorm. Sequence lengths vary and batches can be size 1, so no batch dependence is essential. LayerNorm normalizes each token's feature vector on its own — identical behaviour at train and eval, no running stats.

@@T0@@Small-batch vision &middot; GroupN.zh:
@@T0@@小批量视觉 · GroupNorm。@@T1@@ 它保留了 LayerNorm 的
        批独立性，但把通道分为若干组，从而恢复了 BatchNorm 所利用的
        部分逐通道结构。在批大小为 2 时，它在 ImageNet 上能达到与
        BatchNorm 相当的准确率，而后者此时已经崩溃。
@@T0@@Small-batch vision &middot; GroupN.src: Small-batch vision · GroupNorm. It keeps LayerNorm's batch-independence but splits channels into groups, recovering some of the per-channel structure BatchNorm exploited. It matches BatchNorm's accuracy on ImageNet at batch size 2, where BatchNorm collapses.

@@T0@@Style transfer &middot; InstanceNo.zh:
@@T0@@风格迁移 · InstanceNorm。@@T1@@ 分别独立地归一化每张图像
        与每个通道，会剥离掉逐图像的对比度与色彩统计量 —
        而这些恰恰是你随后想要重新绘制的“风格”，这正是它成为
        风格迁移与许多 GAN 生成器默认选择的原因。
@@T0@@Style transfer &middot; InstanceNo.src: Style transfer · InstanceNorm. Normalizing each image and channel independently strips out per-image contrast and colour statistics — exactly the "style" you then want to repaint, which is why it is the default in style-transfer and many GAN generators.

@@T0@@And RMSNorm?@@T1@@ The modern Tran.zh:
@@T0@@那 RMSNorm 呢？@@T1@@ 这位现代 Transformer 的宠儿其实只是
      去掉了均值中心化的 LayerNorm：$\hat{x} = \gamma \cdot x / \sqrt{\overline{x^2} + \epsilon}$。
      切片与 LayerNorm 相同（在 $C$ 上），但它省去了减去 $\mu$ 的步骤——
      少一个统计量、少一个参数，而准确率几乎相同。这里的每一种方法，
      都是你刚才一路点击所探讨的同一个问题的变体：
      @@T2@@我们究竟在哪些坐标轴上做池化？@@T3@@
@@T0@@And RMSNorm?@@T1@@ The modern Tran.src: And RMSNorm? The modern Transformer favourite is just LayerNorm with the mean-centering dropped: $\hat{x} = \gamma \cdot x / \sqrt{\overline{x^2} + \epsilon}$. Same slice as LayerNorm (across $C$), but it skips subtracting $\mu$ — one fewer statistic and one fewer parameter for near-identical accuracy. Every method here is a variation on the same question you were just clicking through: over which axes do we pool?

meta.summary: 选择一个四维张量（批量、通道、高度、宽度）或一个序列（批量、长度、维度）。在 BN / LN / RMSNorm 之间切换。高亮会显示每种方法究竟在哪一切片上求平均。这对理解为何 BN 主宰 CNN 而 LayerNorm 主宰 Transformer、以及为何 RMSNorm 是现代简化方案至关重要。
